messages.en:
{07 04 00}{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 01 00}{07 16 00}Oh jeez.{01 00 00 0a 00}
Why am I not surprised that{01 00 00 0a 00}
you got stung by bees?
{07 15 00}Are you listening? {01 00 00 14 00}When
bees start chasing you, run
inside the nearest house!
And don't be a slowpoke
about it! {07 00 00}Bees won't go
into houses, {01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}.
messages.et:
{07 04 00}{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 01 00}{07 16 00}Oh issand.{01 00 00 0a 00}
Miks ma ei ole üllatunud,{01 00 00 0a 00}
et mesilased sind nõelasid?

mesilased sind taga ajavad,
jookse lähimasse majja!
Ja ära ole selle juures
aeglane! {07 00 00}Mesilased ei lähe

messages.en:
{07 04 00}What's this?!{01 00 00 14 00}
Looks like those bees{01 00 00 05 00} had a
real field day on your face.
{07 03 00}I'm sorry.{01 00 00 0a 00} I shouldn't laugh,
but have you looked in the
mirror,{01 00 00 0a 00} {04 02 00}?

{07 16 00}Why do you {01 00 00 0a 00}{07 15 00}insist on
fighting bees, {01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}?
Bees always win! {01 00 00 0a 00}ALWAYS!
{01 00 00 0a 00}{07 1b 00}{01 00 00 05 00}You really should{01 00 00 05 00} take
better care{01 00 00 05 00} of yourself,
{01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}.

{07 04 00}{0b 03 00}{01 06 00}My my my...{01 07 00}!{01 00 00 0a 00} I see
you're trying out the rough
and tumble look today, huh?
{07 14 00}Just looking at you makes
my face hurt, {01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}.
messages.et:
{07 04 00}{0b 03 00}{01 06 00}Oh sa kallike...{01 07 00}!{01 00 00 0a 00} Ma näen,
et sa proovid täna
karmi ilmet, mis? {07 14 00}Ainuüksi
sinu vaatamine teeb
mu näole valu, {01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}.

messages.en:
{07 18 00}Yuck!{01 00 00 0a 00} Who are you?!
And why are you talking to
me?{01 00 00 0a 00} Like, ick to the max!
{01 00 00 05 00}Huh?{07 00 00}{01 00 00 05 00} What's that?
{01 00 00 0a 00}{0b 03 00}{04 1f 00}, is that you?

{07 14 00}I'm so sorry, {04 02 00}!{01 00 00 0a 00}

messages.et:
{07 18 00}Jälk!{01 00 00 0a 00} Kes sa oled?!
Ja miks sa minuga
räägid?{01 00 00 0a 00} Nagu, jälk

{07 14 00}Mul on nii kahju, {04 02 00}!{01 00 00 0a 00}
Need nõelamised teevad su
väga kahtlaseks! Aih!

messages.en:
{07 04 00}Oh, no!{01 00 00 0a 00} They really did a

{04 02 00}?

{01 00 00 0a 00}{07 1b 00}{01 00 00 05 00}I mean,{01 00 00 05 00} grow up,
{04 02 00}!

{04 02 00}?
